integrity: A complete analytic determinant and monotonicity proof is supplied; separate exact symbolic and finite numerical checks are reproducible, not independent infinite-dimensional certification. Heller 1957 full text was inaccessible and may affect priority.
scientific_limitations: Only symmetric positive-definite irreducible odd weighted cycles, exact once-per-sweep coordinate minimization, and asymptotic spectral radius. No assertion about optimal finite-time norms, over-relaxation, other graph topologies, or historical publication priority.
title: Exact optimal cyclic coordinate orderings on arbitrary weighted odd rings
